description_en: Uncompromised Protection. Transparent Beauty.

Redefining clean skincare by eliminating the compromise between high-performance results and gentle formulations. Transforming routines into effortless rituals with weightless textures and visible results.
description_kr: 고기능성 결과와 순한 처방 사이의 타협을 없애 클린 스킨케어를 재정의합니다. 가벼운 제형과 가시적인 효과로 일상의 루틴을 손쉬운 리추얼로 변화시킵니다.

description_en: Radical Transparency and Clinical Efficacy. Formulated with proven heroes like Snail Mucin and Heartleaf to protect, repair, and enhance the skin barrier.
description_kr: 철저한 투명성과 임상적 효능. 스네일 뮤신, 어성초와 같은 검증된 성분으로 피부 장벽을 보호, 복구 및 강화합니다.

description_en: Strictly transparent, highly effective ingredients. Guaranteed non-comedogenic, dermatologist-tested, and irritation-free finishes.
description_kr: 엄격하게 투명하고 고효능의 성분만을 사용합니다. 여드름 유발 방지(Non-comedogenic), 피부과 테스트 완료, 무자극 마무리를 보장합니다.

description_en: K-Beauty reimagined for the ingredient-conscious generation. No compromises. No secrets. Just results.
description_kr: 성분을 중시하는 세대를 위해 재해석된 K-뷰티. 타협도, 비밀도 없습니다. 오직 결과로 말합니다.

description_en: A whipped, cloud-like cream formulated with Ceramide NP and Panthenol to repair the skin barrier without the heavy feel. Perfect for 'Skin Cycling' nights or soothing irritation after active treatments.
tagline: Weightless recovery for a resilient skin barrier.
main_ingredients: Ceramide NP, Panthenol (Vitamin B5), Triple Hyaluronic Acid
ingredient_benefits: Ceramides restore skin barrier; Panthenol soothes irritation; Hyaluronic acid provides multi-depth hydration.
skin_concerns: Dehydration, Redness, Flakiness, Irritation from Retinoids
usage_guide: Apply as the final step in your PM routine or whenever skin feels sensitized. Massage gently until absorbed.
tiktok_hook: #SkinCycling savior, #CloudTexture ASMR, Barrier repair for active skin
marketing_angle: The ultimate recovery cream for the ingredient-conscious consumer. Viral 'Cloud' texture.
market_trend: Fits the 'Skin Cycling' recovery night trend in the US.

description_en: A nutrient-rich milky toner inspired by the 'Glazed Skin' trend. It combines the deep hydration of a cream with the lightweight feel of a toner to prep and plump the skin.
tagline: The essential first step for an effortless Glass Skin glow.
main_ingredients: Ceramide NP, Rice Bran Extract, Niacinamide, Glycerin
ingredient_benefits: Rice bran brightens tone; Niacinamide refines pores; Ceramide seals in moisture.
target_skin_type: All Skin Types, especially Dull or Dry
skin_concerns: Dullness, Rough Texture, Lack of Radiance
usage_guide: Pat into clean skin using hands. Layer 2-3 times for a high-gloss finish.
key_claims: Vegan, Fragrance-Free, Clean Beauty, Glass Skin approved
marketing_angle: Achieve the Hailey Bieber 'Rhode' aesthetic with K-Beauty innovation.
market_trend: Rides the 'Glazing' trend popularized by Rhode/Hailey Bieber.

description_en: Dual-sided cooling pads soaked in Heartleaf extract to detoxify and calm skin instantly. Designed for the generation on the move—perfect after a workout or a long day in the sun.
tagline: Instant redness relief for active lifestyles.
main_ingredients: Houttuynia Cordata (Heartleaf) Extract, Wintergreen Leaf Extract (Natural BHA), Allantoin
ingredient_benefits: Heartleaf detoxifies and calms; Wintergreen mildly exfoliates; Allantoin protects.
skin_concerns: Active Breakouts, Post-Gym Redness, Excess Sebum
texture: Dual-sided embossed cotton pads soaked in watery essence
finish: Instant cooling sensation, refreshing, no residue
usage_guide: Swipe the embossed side to exfoliate, then leave the smooth side on red areas for 5 minutes as a targeted mask.
tiktok_hook: #PostWorkout routine, Redness relief in 60 seconds, K-Beauty travel hack
market_trend: Addresses 'Maskne' and hard-water-induced skin sensitivity in US regions.

description_en: A high-performance SOS mist utilizing Hypochlorous Acid to combat bacteria and inflammation. It mimics the body's natural immune response to heal breakouts and soothe eczema-prone skin.
tagline: The ultimate anti-bacterial shield for troubled skin.
main_ingredients: Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl), Electrolyzed Water, Sodium Chloride
ingredient_benefits: Naturally produced by white blood cells to fight bacteria; Anti-inflammatory; Speeds up healing.
usage_guide: Mist over face or body after sweating, or as a treatment step before serums. Safe for use throughout the day.
key_claims: Non-Toxic, pH Balanced, Dermatologist Recommended, Fragrance-Free
tiktok_hook: #SOSMist, Antibacterial skin hack, Gym bag essential
marketing_angle: The 'miracle spray' for post-gym breakouts and 'Maskne' prevention.
market_trend: Hypochlorous acid is a viral 'miracle' ingredient in US dermatological circles (e.g., Tower 28 style).

description_en: A powerhouse essence blending ethically sourced Snail Mucin with barrier-strengthening Ceramides. This multi-functional formula targets fine lines, dark spots, and texture for a smooth, glass-like finish.
tagline: K-Beauty's gold standard for skin repair and plumping.
main_ingredients: Snail Secretion Filtrate (92%), Ceramide NP, Adenosine
ingredient_benefits: Snail mucin repairs damaged tissue; Adenosine provides anti-aging benefits; Ceramide strengthens skin.
skin_concerns: Fine Lines, Dark Spots, Sun Damage, Texture loss
usage_guide: Apply to damp skin after toning. Pat gently to aid absorption.
tiktok_hook: The #SnailMucin glow-up, Slime texture ASMR, Barrier protector
marketing_angle: Already a US bestseller component, now enhanced with Barrier Care.
market_trend: Snail Mucin remains a Top 3 K-Beauty search term on Amazon US.

product_name_en: Vegan Vitamin C Brightening Jelly Mask
product_name_kr: 비건 비타민 C 브라이트닝 젤리 마스크
description_en: A high-potency Vitamin C treatment delivered in a unique jelly-textured sheet. It provides an immediate antioxidant boost to brighten dullness and even out skin tone.
tagline: Eco-conscious brightening for an instant event-ready glow.
main_ingredients: Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate (Stable Vit C), Niacinamide, Glutathione
ingredient_benefits: Stable Vit C brightens without irritation; Niacinamide targets pores; Glutathione is a master antioxidant.
target_skin_type: All Skin Types, especially Dull or Sun-damaged
usage_guide: Apply to clean skin for 15-20 minutes. Massage remaining essence into face and neck. No rinsing required.
tiktok_hook: #InstantGlow mask, Prep for the weekend, Jelly mask aesthetic
marketing_angle: Instant gratification for 'Clean Girl' prep routines.

description_en: A low-pH gel-to-foam cleanser that pairs the antioxidant power of Matcha with Salicylic Acid to dissolve oil and debris while keeping the skin barrier intact.
tagline: Deep pore cleansing that respects your skin's natural balance.
main_ingredients: Matcha Green Tea Extract, Salicylic Acid (BHA 0.5%), Green Tea Leaf Water
ingredient_benefits: Matcha provides antioxidants; BHA dissolves pore-clogging oil; Green tea soothes.
texture: Creamy gel that transforms into dense foam
finish: Deeply clean but not stripped (pH balanced)
usage_guide: Lather a small amount in wet hands and massage onto face. Rinse with lukewarm water.
tiktok_hook: #PoreCare routine, Matcha power, pH balanced cleaning
marketing_angle: The perfect second step for a K-Beauty double cleanse.
market_trend: Growing awareness of the 'Acid Mantle' and low pH cleansing in the US.

description_en: A 100% mineral sun stick that provides broad-spectrum protection with a natural, blurring tone-up effect. Designed for easy re-application over makeup without clogging pores.
tagline: No-mess, reef-safe protection for on-the-go lifestyle.
main_ingredients: Zinc Oxide, Titanium Dioxide, Calamine, Vitamin E
ingredient_benefits: Physical filters block UV; Calamine calms and provides pinkish tone-up; Vit E protects from pollutants.
target_skin_type: Sensitive, Fair to Medium tones, Outdoor enthusiasts
skin_concerns: UV Damage, Sensitive to Chemical Sunscreens, Blue Light
finish: Natural brightening, soft-blur, no white cast (optimized)
usage_guide: Glide directly onto skin or over makeup. Re-apply every 2 hours during sun exposure.
key_claims: SPF 50+ PA++++, Reef-Safe (Hawaii compliant), Non-Nano, Vegan
marketing_angle: Environmentally conscious protection that fits in your pocket.
market_trend: High demand for 'Reef-safe' mineral formulas in coastal US states.

description_en: A lightweight, water-soluble cleansing oil that uses Soybean and Jojoba oils to dissolve waterproof makeup and pollutants while mimicking the skin's natural oils for a soft, balanced finish.
tagline: Effortlessly melt away the day with heritage ingredients.
main_ingredients: Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil (50%), Jojoba Seed Oil, Sunflower Seed Oil
ingredient_benefits: Soybean oil dissolves makeup; Jojoba mimics skin sebum for balance; Sunflower oil prevents moisture loss.
target_skin_type: All Skin Types, even Oily (oil dissolves oil)
skin_concerns: Waterproof Makeup, Sebaceous Filaments, Sunscreen Residue
finish: Clean, soft, no oily film left behind
usage_guide: Massage onto dry face to dissolve makeup. Add water to emulsify, then rinse thoroughly.
tiktok_hook: #DoubleCleansing routine, Melt your makeup, Blackhead removal hack
market_trend: The 'Double Cleansing' method is now a standard 'Clean Girl' aesthetic ritual in the US.

description_en: US Gen Z and Millennials seeking clean, effective, and ethically produced skincare.
description_kr: 클린하고 효과적이며 윤리적으로 생산된 스킨케어를 찾는 미국 MZ세대.
